verdict.rationale: Gram ships an official CLI that can authenticate, stage OpenAPI/Functions, push and monitor deployments, and install toolsets as MCP servers entirely from the terminal — all scriptable actions suitable for CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/automation guide, no mention of non-interactive/token-based auth for pipelines, and no GitHub Actions or similar CI integration example. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive auth flow for CI, explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions), and confirmation of headless operation without a browser/dashboard step.
